content.text: Today's AI landscape is shifting decisively from experimentation to deployment. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone, with adoption tripling as companies move beyond prototypes. Startups are increasingly letting model-driven agents replace hand-coded orchestration, streamlining development cycles. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models, signaling a maturation of capabilities beyond raw intelligence. Multi-agent swarms are no longer just demos — they're entering regulated enterprise workflows, where accountability matters. To meet this demand, observability standards are emerging to trace agent decisions end to end, ensuring trust and transparency across the ecosystem
